lines.zh: 我有很多脚，走起来沙沙响。
lines.en: Many feet, and they whisper as I walk.

lines.zh: 我是幽荧灵产下的第一只。
lines.en: I am the first one the spectre laid.
The smell of lichen lies ahead.

lines.zh: 我爬过石阶，一节一节拱。
lines.en: I climb the stone step, segment by segment.
My body gives off a pale green glow.
I am looking for the nearest lichen rack.
Three siblings trail behind me.
Slower; I have not eaten enough.

lines.zh: 我的足尖黏在湿石头上。
lines.en: My feet stick to the wet stone.
The cave is dark, yet I see fine.
No cordyceps has grown on my back yet.
I walk along the moss edge.

lines.zh: 饿了就得爬，没别的办法。
lines.en: Hungry means crawling; there is no other way.
This stone is too slick; I go around.

lines.zh: 我一节一节往下爬，光跟着动。
lines.en: I inch down and my glow follows.

lines.zh: 地衣架的气味从前面飘来。
lines.en: The smell of a lichen shelf drifts near.
I stop, but my feet keep moving.
The light on me pulses in and out.
I count how many segments I have.
The lichen smell makes me daze.

lines.zh: 我缩起来，像一枚绿钉子。
lines.en: I curl up like a green nail.

lines.zh: 洞顶一直在滴水，滴得我心烦。
lines.en: The roof keeps dripping, and it wears on me.
I am waiting to grow up.
A sibling presses against me, still.
I licked the moss on the stone.

lines.zh: 光太弱了，是不是没吃饱。
lines.en: My light is faint; maybe I have not eaten enough.

lines.zh: 我听见幽荧灵在洞深处飞。
lines.en: I hear a spectre flying deep in the cave.
This segment feels swollen.
Your shadow is huge.
Is that lichen in your hand?
I look up, my neck bending like a bow.
You are so big you will step on me.
I watch you from the crack.
Your boots are warmer than the stone.

lines.zh: 我认得幽荧灵，不认得你。
lines.en: I know spectres; I do not know you.
Do not poke me with your finger.
You smell dry, like sun-baked stone.
I am busy eating; do not talk yet.
My segment shell cracked.
Do not step; I am truly small.
I curl up and my light goes out.
You knocked off one of my legs.
I spin in pain.
I will remember this until I grow up.

lines.zh: 我身上的黏液都出来了。
lines.en: My slime is all oozing out.
I burrow into the crack.

lines.zh: 别翻我，翻过来我起不来。
lines.en: Do not flip me; I cannot right myself.
One more step and I am flattened.
Lichen, that is the smell of lichen.
Give me a piece; it lasts me long.
Did you break that off a lichen rack?
I am crawling toward you.
Do not wave it; I cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 吃够了，我就能变成幽荧灵。
lines.en: Eat enough and I become a spectre.
Moss will do; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 那股潮味，让我忘了害怕。
lines.en: That damp smell makes me forget fear.
A little more; I am a few bites short.

lines.zh: 你把它放地上，我自己过去。
lines.en: Put it down; I will come myself.
You stepped on my tail segment.
The bump left me on my back, legs up.
My feet stuck to your sole.
Do not kick; I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 两只幼虫挤在一起，光更亮。
lines.en: Two larvae together glow brighter.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的背，那里还软。
lines.en: You touched my back; it is still soft.
I nudged you; sorry.

lines.zh: 石头都比你让路让得多。
lines.en: Even the stones yield more than you.
My segments ache from the knock.
Step back half a pace and I crawl away.

lines.zh: 我还小，这些事轮不到我。
lines.en: I am young; that is not for me yet.

lines.zh: 幽荧灵才繁殖，我是幼虫。
lines.en: Spectres breed; I am only a larva.
We came four to a clutch.
Wait until I grow wings.

lines.zh: 你找错虫了，我不是成体。
lines.en: You have the wrong bug; I am not an adult.
My body is not ready.

lines.zh: 洞里会多几只幼虫，那是以后的事。
lines.en: More larvae will come later; that is for later.
Let me eat my fill first.

lines.zh: 这种事要在有地衣的洞深处。
lines.en: That sort of thing belongs deep in a lichen cave.
I cannot even crawl fast yet.
My mouthparts are too small to grip it.
That thing weighs more than I do.
I push with my front legs; it will not budge.
The crumbs that fall are mine.
You take it; I will wait.
I can only carry a scrap of moss.
It rolled into the hole.

lines.zh: 我的足打滑，抓不住石面。
lines.en: My feet slip; they cannot grip the stone.
That is stone, not food.
I bit it once and my jaw hurts.
You trampled the lichen rack.
I rear up my front half.
That is my moss; leave it.
I hiss, very thin and small.
I do not like being picked up.
You are blocking my path to food.
The light on me turns red.
You grabbed my sibling.
I will bite your finger.
Do not flip me over.
My bite hurts; do not test it.
Back off; I am going back to the crack.
I follow along your footprints.
Do not think small means I cannot follow.

lines.zh: 我钻进石缝，绕到你后面。
lines.en: I slip into the crack and circle behind you.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就近一寸。
lines.en: Each step you retreat, I gain an inch.
My glow travels low along the ground.
You cannot step on me; I am too low.

lines.zh: 地衣的碎屑把你暴露了。
lines.en: The lichen crumbs give you away.
I take my time; I am in no hurry.
You still hold that moss.
I trace small circles around you.
Do you hear the feet?
I crawl toward the opening of your boot.
I lunge and stick to your calf.
One bite, not a heavy one.

lines.zh: 我的节甲撞在你骨头上。
lines.en: My segments knock against your bone.
You had to shake twice to throw me off.
I ram with my whole body.

lines.zh: 这一下，我自己也弹开了。
lines.en: That one bounced me off too.
My jaws are small and hard.
You kicked, and I still bit.
I only wanted you to leave.
I will not let go even if I lose.
I chew my way out of the egg.
Four in the clutch, and I am the thinnest.
A spectre flies over my head.
My first bite was lichen.
The cave floor is cold and wet.
Egg membrane still clings to me.
My siblings have already scattered.
I must find a lichen rack.
The glow starts in my first segment.

lines.zh: 这么小的身体，也要吃东西。
lines.en: Even a body this small must eat.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的节甲卷起来。
lines.en: Fire makes my segments curl.

lines.zh: 从石壁上掉下，弹了两下。
lines.en: I drop from the wall and bounce twice.

lines.zh: 水漫过我，光在水里散开。
lines.en: Water covers me; my glow spreads in it.
The blast throws me out of the crack.
An arrow pins me to the moss.
Magic numbs my legs.

lines.zh: 没有地衣，我的光要灭了。
lines.en: No lichen, and my light is dying.

lines.zh: 雷声让我整条身子缩紧。
lines.en: Thunder makes my whole body clench.

lines.zh: 虚空很空，连味道都没有。
lines.en: The void is empty, without even a smell.
